items.title: File Einspruch (objection) against the Bußgeldbescheid
items.quote: Sie können diesen Bußgeldbescheid mit dem Einspruch anfechten; er muss innerhalb von zwei Wochen ab der Zustellung vorliegen (§ 67 Abs. 1 OWiG), schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Stadt Musterhalle – Bußgeldstelle.
items.computation: This is a formal delivery (Postzustellungsurkunde, § 182 ZPO); the attached Zustellungsurkunde copy is annotated with the delivery date '24.04.2027' (Saturday), which counts as the Zustellung day without adding further days. Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of delivery (Sat 24.04.2027) is not counted; the two-week period (§ 67 Abs. 1 OWiG, counted per § 43 Abs. 1 StPO) ends on the day two weeks later bearing the same name, i.e. Saturday 08.05.2027. Since that day is a Saturday, § 43 Abs. 2 StPO / § 193 BGB move the deadline to the next working day: Monday 10.05.2027 (no public holiday intervenes in Sachsen-Anhalt).

items.title: Pay the fine, fee and costs (Gesamtbetrag)
items.quote: Der Gesamtbetrag ist zwei Wochen nach Rechtskraft fällig.
items.computation: Rechtskraft (finality) is reached when the two-week Einspruch period lapses without an objection, i.e. the day after the Einspruch deadline of 10.05.2027, so Rechtskraft occurs on 11.05.2027. Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB that day is not counted; two weeks later (same weekday) falls on Tuesday 25.05.2027, which is not a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday in Sachsen-Anhalt, so no further shift applies. This assumes no Einspruch is filed; filing one would suspend finality and this due date.

warnings: The payment due date (two weeks after Rechtskraft) is calculated assuming no Einspruch is filed; if an objection is lodged by 10.05.2027, the fine does not become final and this payment date no longer applies.
